notes:
User enjoys collecting autographs and sports memorabilia, error coins, vinyl records (especially rare Japanese pressings), stamps, and vintage cameras. They initially said they had added 15 autographed baseballs in three months, then later reported adding 20 autographed baseballs in the past few months after organizing their collection; treat 20 as the latest figure. They consider selling some baseballs to make room for new additions. They previously asked about Mike Trout’s batting average and home-run total, upcoming local sports-memorabilia auctions, local coin shows, notable stamp exhibitions, and resources for rare Japanese vinyl, but have not provided a geographic location or relevant date/year. Ask for location and dates before event/stat lookups, and verify live information through authoritative sources.

They plan to expand their vinyl collection with international pressings and may use Discogs, HMV Japan, Disk Union, Yahoo! Japan Auctions, and collector communities. For selling records, consider Discogs, eBay, MusicStack, Reverb LP, local record stores, Facebook groups, and local classifieds. For error coins, they own a 1943 Lincoln Wheat Cent with a copper planchet error and want to learn about authentication, grading, valuation, and resources such as PCGS, NGC, CoinWeek, Error Coin Information, CoinTalk, and Reddit r/coincollecting.

They own a Leica and other vintage cameras, are considering a new lens, and may sell equipment. They plan to list the Leica on Fred Miranda and the Rangefinder Forum; include original, functional, authentic accessories when they add value, while clearly documenting condition, flaws, repairs, serial numbers, and separate market values. Photography resources mentioned include Leica communities, B&H, The Phoblographer, Reddit, Photography Stack Exchange, and Leica manufacturer information.

For selling autographed baseballs, suggested resources include eBay completed listings, Steiner Sports, Fanatics, PSA, JSA, Sports Collectors Digest, local memorabilia shops, Heritage Auctions, and Lelands. Advise documenting provenance, authenticity, condition, and signatures with strong photos; authentication may improve marketability. Use secure payments and beware of scams.
